text:
alex_m: Heads-up: partner 'EdgeCompute' reported missing usage for a subset of on-prem boxes in EU — gaps around 2025-03-14 to 2025-03-16.
chris_eng: Can you paste a sample payload? Are their timestamps in UTC or local TZ? Could be the timezone mismatch we saw before. :thinking_face:
alex_m: Here's a redacted sample we got from their gateway:
```json
{
  "customer_id": "cust-738",
  "usage": 1200,
  "period_start": "2025-03-14T00:00:00+01:00",
  "period_end": "2025-03-14T23:59:59+01:00",
  "metering_id": "mtr-92"
}
```
maya-gtm: @alex_m thanks. Quick Q — are they routed via Azure Marketplace metering or direct partner gateway for billing? Need to know if we credit marketplace or our invoice ledger.
alex_m: They're on Azure Marketplace RES (metering) for the EU account, *and* they also have an on-prem license that posts to our partner gateway. So two paths.
rachel_fin: If both paths reported for the same consumption window we should dedupe before billing. What key do we currently use for idempotency/dedup? metering_id? invoice_key?
chris_eng: We currently dedupe on (partner_id, metering_id, period_start). Problem: the on-prem gateway seems to generate a fresh metering_id each batch, so same usage gets different IDs.
chris_eng: Proposed reconciliation approach: aggregate by customer_id + UTC date, compare totals against marketplace reports, flag deltas > 1%, and surface per-customer diffs for manual review. Then run backfill for missing batches.
alex_m: Plan: 1) Collect full publish history from EdgeCompute for 3/10-3/20; 2) Run recon job with a 1% tolerance; 3) If missing, either request partner resend or apply credit to affected invoices. Who can own the recon job?
chris_eng: I'll own the recon job. Implementation notes: normalize all timestamps to UTC on ingestion, bucket by UTC date for comparison, keep original timezone string in metadata for audit. Also emit run_id for tracing.
rachel_fin: Marketplace reconciliation should be UTC-aligned — agree on UTC buckets for the recon. Keep original tz in the event metadata so finance can audit any later disputes.
marketplace-bot: Deploy scheduled job 'partner-metering-recon' created by chris_eng — next run scheduled 2025-03-20 01:00 UTC.
maya-gtm: :thumbsup: I'll notify EdgeCompute, ask them to re-send missing batches and provide their historical payloads. Preparing a customer-facing note in case we need to apply credits.
alex_m: Thanks all. Please tag recon outputs with run-id and include a CSV summary (customer, day, our_total, partner_total, delta_pct). We'll loop back after the first run and decide credit vs partner resend.
